prerequisites: Basic knowledge of electrical engineering, such as Kirchhoff's laws and complex AC and three-phase current calculation.
Refreshing fundamental relationships concerning magnetic fields is particularly helpful for preparation.

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the structure and constructive peculiarities of the different machine types.
Present the electromagnetic operating principle of the different machine types.
Derive the operating behavior from the electromagnetic operating principle and describe it using an analytical equation model.

Perform basic practical tests on electrical machines. They master the analytical and graphical evaluation of measurement protocols and can present the test results in a technically sound and audience-appropriate manner using current visualization media.
Transfer the electromagnetic operating principle of electromagnetic energy converters into analytical calculation methods for investigating various operating conditions.
Numerically investigate detailed questions on specific operating points of machines and determine operating parameters.
Utilize a toolbox for independent processing of drive technology questions within the framework of specific energy technology and mechatronics issues.
Compare application limits and potentials of different machine types to critically evaluate their suitability for certain drive tasks.
Recognize the necessity for integrating electrical machines into electrical drive systems.
Assess the suitability of different machine types for various drive types.
Evaluate questions regarding the sustainability of different electric drives for specific drive tasks.
Classify and critically reflect on common marketing terms and statements about electric drives.
Technically classify new drive concepts within the energy transition process and electromobility.
Question societal statements and assessments about them.

Recognize the necessity for integrating electrical machines into electrical systems and derive system-relevant design questions. They are able to describe the electrical machine as the main component of an electrical drive system and extract the critical interface parameters to the other system components.

Through the acquired methodology for converting real energy converters into analytical calculation models, they are enabled to transfer this approach to other electro-technical, especially energy-technical systems.

Prepare, present, discuss, and defend results of selected metrological analyses and calculations in a group and in a team. They have learned to present their results at a level suitable for communication with clients or superiors after entering professional life.

syllabus_topics: Structure, operating principle and operating behavior of DC machines
Structure, operating principle and operating behavior of three-phase synchronous machines
Structure, operating principle and operating behavior of three-phase asynchronous machines
assessment_rules: The preferred examination format is an oral examination lasting 30 minutes. Alternatively, a two-hour written exam can be taken. Within the practical component, a total of three experimental reports must be prepared in small groups. The graded examination performance duration for the oral exam is specified in the general part of the examination regulations, and for the written exam in the applicable study regulations. The ungraded experimental work consists of three experiments.
